laws.rule: Maasai Mara National Reserve (Narok County) 2025/26 fees, non-residents: adults USD 200 a person (about A$284, RBA rate of 30 October 2026) July to December, USD 100 (about A$142) January to June; children 9 to 17 and students USD 50; children 8 and under free.
laws.heading: Masaai Mara National Reserve 2025/26 park fees and charges

laws.rule: Amboseli National Park (Kajiado County), KWS rates: non-resident adults US$90 (about A$128 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), children US$45 (about A$63.92 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026). Gates 6 am to 6 pm. Single-use plastic is prohibited; no hooting or drink-driving; stay in vehicles except at designated areas, keep 20 m from wildlife, 40 km/h limit, no off-road driving.
laws.heading: Amboseli National Park rates and rules

local-law.note: Maasai Mara only. The county schedule is for 2025/26; check for a 2026/27 schedule. Amboseli fees follow the Wildlife Conservation and Management (Access, Entry and Conservation) (Fees) Regulations 2025 (Legal Notice 160 of 2025, in force 1 October 2025; Kenya Law copy blocked from here). No RBA rate for KES.
